description:
1. Cognos Development 70%
 2. SQL Development 20%
 3. Requirements gathering / Customer Interaction 10% 
 JOB SUMMARY  

 Responsible for the design, development, implementation and support of Business Intelligence solutions utilizing the IBM Cognos suite of tools. The candidate should have current experience on Cognos 10.x. 

 Must be familiar with Business Intelligence and Data Warehouse concepts and have practical, hands-on experience developing BI solutions. Must also possess strong SQL skills including writing custom SQL scripts from scratch. 

 Experience within Healthcare is a major plus. Experience with SQL Server databases and / or SSIS is a plus as well. 

 KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES 

 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 Advanced logical thinker with proven ability to perform detailed data analysis and make sound decisions 

 Advanced troubleshooting abilities, with ability to problem solve complex technical issues independently within a timely fashion
 Advanced ability to gather and analyze complex data, utilizing deductive reasoning
 Must demonstrate excellent professional communication skills through clearly written, concise, and comprehensive documentation
 Must be capable of testing solutions developed in order to ascertain adherence to specifications
 Facilitate discussions and business requirements with internal and external customers
 Updates management on project activity status
 EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 

 Include minimum education, technical training, and/or experience required to perform the job.
 Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business/MIS, Computer Information Systems, or Computer Science  

 Intermediate experience in writing / executing SQL queries required.
 SQL Server experience is a plus.
 Experience working in Healthcare is preferred. 
 Experience working in Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management is preferred.
 Experience working in Patient Accounting Systems is preferred. 
   Interview Information: 
   Phone then F2F  


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6+ Months Contract 
 
 INTERVIEW: Telephonic and Face 2 face
